title: Session Start Receipt
description: Machine-produced session-start receipt (M5 phase 4, #3777): captures checkout identity (repo/branch/SHA relative to origin/main) and the inputs to the advisory staleness liveness check. Emitted by `cargo xtask session-receipt --json`. Advisory only -- `stale_warning` firing is visibility, not a build gate. Uniformly fail-closed: any field this receipt cannot actually verify reports null, never a value that looks like a confirmed fact.

repo.description: owner/repo, derived from `git config --get remote.origin.url` (the same source `git fetch origin` resolves against), never from `gh`'s auth context. Null when the remote is missing or unparseable -- fail-closed, never a mismatched guess.

fetch_ok.description: Whether `git fetch origin main` succeeded. When false, origin_main_sha/behind_origin_main/ahead are all null -- fail-closed rather than silently reporting 0-behind.

dirty.description: Null when `git status --porcelain` failed to run -- fail-closed rather than ever reporting a false clean. See dirty_check_ok.

dirty_check_ok.description: Whether the `git status --porcelain` call that produced `dirty` succeeded. `dirty` is only meaningful when this is true.

program.description: Resolved program id, validated via goals::manifest::validate_program_id (bare id, no path separators/.., manifest exists). Null when unresolved or invalid -- see program_note.

program_note.description: Populated when program is null because the candidate id failed validation (as opposed to simply being absent).

warn_threshold.description: The commits-behind-origin/main threshold in effect when stale_warning was computed.

stale_warning.description: Populated only when behind_origin_main exceeds warn_threshold. Advisory text, never a build-blocking condition.
